approvalNote: ATAG confirmed the corrected mass-based masterbatch, allowance-once, single-subtotal, length-scope and production-time ownership rules. The complete mapped case remains pending until its workbook identity, source map and corrected expected outputs are approved together.

confirmedRules.coreStartupScope: The 200 m start-up applies to the conductor and first insulation layer only.
confirmedRules.secondLayerScope: Only the 10,000 m finished quote length receives the second insulation layer.
confirmedRules.usageAllowance: The 3% general waste/start-up allowance applies exactly once to every material stream in both layers.
confirmedRules.subtotalInclusion: Each resulting material price is included exactly once in the material subtotal.
confirmedRules.masterbatchBasis: Both layers calculate masterbatch from allowance-adjusted compound mass, never from compound litres.
confirmedRules.masterbatchProductionTime: Masterbatch contributes material amount and cost only and has no separate production time.
confirmedRules.extrusionTimeOwnership: The first and second extrusion processes own independent size-to-speed profiles and labour inputs.

knownWorkbookDefects.description: The masterbatch price multiplies V26 by 1.03 even though V26 already comes from the first compound mass after its 3% allowance. The zero supplier price hides this defect in the cached result.
